findingClass: a field_sources.verdict does not match what CONFIRMED/DISPUTED/UNCONFIRMED/SINGLE_SOURCE/NO_WITNESS the row's own stored witnesses actually support -- the verdict writer (S3b-2, dormant behind ENABLE_VERDICT_WRITER) computed the wrong state, or a row carries no verdict at all despite having 2+ real witness answers on a non-ABSTAIN field
failThreshold: any field_sources row (non-ABSTAIN field, manifest-mapped) whose stored verdict differs from the verdict re-derived by the SAME computeVerdict function the writer calls, given the row's own witnesses and its IPO's segment-scoped capable-source count
unverifiableWhen: the target database is unreachable (hard FATAL, exit 1 -- never a silent skip, matching assert-row-key-constraints.ts's philosophy)
sourceTask: S7 (docs/design/s7-consensus-check-plan.md) half 1 -- the justification for ever flipping ENABLE_VERDICT_WRITER on
scope: every field_sources row across all three segments (MAINBOARD, SME_BSE, SME_NSE), all IPO statuses, both slots (prod/staging), rows written before AND after this check exists. ABSTAIN fields (14 in the manifest) are excluded by design -- a null verdict there is correct.
